policy: Abhidhamma and commentary are named as their own provenance layers. Pāli blocks are reproduced only from exact Bilara IDs. Copyrighted English editions are reference-only and paraphrased. Science may test health or cognitive outcomes but cannot validate kamma, rebirth, cosmology, Nibbāna, or momentariness.

lessons.title: Vi Diệu Pháp Nhập Môn — Tâm, Tâm Sở, Sắc, Nibbāna

claims.claim: Dhammasaṅgaṇī opens with wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena
The unconditioned is an early-sutta anchor for Nibbāna
The fourfold citta–cetasika–rūpa–Nibbāna teaching map is a later pedagogical synthesis
claims.location: Chapters I–II and VI; four ultimate realities overview

lessons.title: Tâm Sở Và Sát-na Tâm — Bản Đồ Vi Mô Của Kinh Nghiệm

claims.claim: MN 111 analyzes factors present in meditative consciousness
SN 12.61 describes mind/consciousness as arising and ceasing by night and day
Dhammasaṅgaṇī classifies phenomena by thought and investigation
The 52-cetasika and detailed mind-moment combination scheme is a later manual systematization
claims.location: Chapter II, Compendium of Mental Factors

lessons.title: Paṭṭhāna — Hai Mươi Bốn Duyên Và Mạng Điều Kiện

claims.claim: Specific conditionality remains whether or not a Tathāgata appears
SN 12.23 presents a non-linear supporting sequence from suffering through faith to liberation knowledge
Theravāda Paṭṭhāna tradition analyzes a standard set of 24 paccaya; this article presents the conventional list conservatively without claiming a machine-verified root-table location

lessons.title: Theravāda Và Khoa Học Hiện Đại — Điểm Gặp, Giới Hạn Và Lối Tắt Sai

claims.claim: AN 3.65 rejects reliance on tradition, inference, appearance, or teacher-status alone
SN 22.59 is an experiential no-self analysis, not a neuroscience claim
Meditation research supports bounded clinical/cognitive questions only

acceptance_gates: Do not attribute the fourfold ultimate-realities teaching map or 52-cetasika scheme directly to early suttas.
Do not claim neuroscience proves rapid mind moments or momentariness.
Do not quote a Paṭṭhāna root unless a stable licensed machine-readable edition is locked; use bibliography and paraphrase instead.
Do not use meditation benefits, brain imaging, quantum language, NDEs, or consciousness theories as proof of Buddhist metaphysics.
Keep source_license_checked false until exact-scripture, bibliography, semantic, and science-evidence audits pass.
bilara_normalization_policy: Store raw segment hash; strip editorial HTML tags such as ... deterministically; normalize surrounding whitespace only; compare the article Pāli to the stripped fetched text.
